objective: Extender el contrato puro de backend/modules/cava_socios/domain.py con el vocabulario y validaciones del Kardex inmutable de botella. No alterar SQL ni rutas. Mantener compatibilidad conceptual con movimientos legacy, pero definir el modelo destino completo: ENTRADA, REUBICACION, TRANSFERENCIA, SALIDA_SERVICIO, APERTURA, CONSUMO_PARCIAL, CONSUMO_TOTAL, RETORNO, RETIRO, ROTURA, MERMA, AJUSTE, TRANSFERENCIA_PROPIEDAD, BLOQUEO y DESBLOQUEO. Cada evento debe identificar botella, asignación, actor, saldo anterior/nuevo y evidencia opcional; las transiciones cuantitativas deben ser coherentes y nunca reescribir eventos anteriores.

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    BottleLedgerEvent,
    BottleLedgerEventType,
    consumed_delta,
    validate_bottle_ledger_event,
)


def _event(event_type, previous=1.0, new=1.0, reason=None):
    return BottleLedgerEvent(
        event_id="EV-1",
        bottle_id="BOT-1",
        assignment_id="ASG-1",
        event_type=event_type,
        actor_user_id="USR-1",
        previous_balance=previous,
        new_balance=new,
        reason=reason,
    )


def test_full_movement_vocabulary_is_frozen():
    assert {item.value for item in BottleLedgerEventType} == {
        "ENTRADA", "REUBICACION", "TRANSFERENCIA", "SALIDA_SERVICIO",
        "APERTURA", "CONSUMO_PARCIAL", "CONSUMO_TOTAL", "RETORNO",
        "RETIRO", "ROTURA", "MERMA", "AJUSTE",
        "TRANSFERENCIA_PROPIEDAD", "BLOQUEO", "DESBLOQUEO",
    }


def test_incremental_consumption_is_delta_not_resulting_level():
    assert consumed_delta(1.0, 0.5) == 0.5
    assert consumed_delta(0.5, 0.25) == 0.25
    assert consumed_delta(0.25, 0.0) == 0.25


def test_partial_and_total_consumption_transitions():
    validate_bottle_ledger_event(_event(BottleLedgerEventType.CONSUMO_PARCIAL, 1.0, 0.5))
    validate_bottle_ledger_event(_event(BottleLedgerEventType.CONSUMO_TOTAL, 0.25, 0.0))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_bottle_ledger_event(_event(BottleLedgerEventType.CONSUMO_PARCIAL, 0.5, 0.75))


def test_opening_and_relocation_do_not_consume_product():
    validate_bottle_ledger_event(_event(BottleLedgerEventType.APERTURA, 1.0, 1.0))
    validate_bottle_ledger_event(_event(BottleLedgerEventType.REUBICACION, 0.5, 0.5))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_bottle_ledger_event(_event(BottleLedgerEventType.APERTURA, 1.0, 0.75))


def test_adjustment_requires_auditable_reason():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_bottle_ledger_event(_event(BottleLedgerEventType.AJUSTE, 0.5, 0.75))
    validate_bottle_ledger_event(_event(BottleLedgerEventType.AJUSTE, 0.5, 0.75, reason="Inventario fisico certificado"))


def test_event_requires_assignment_and_actor():
    event = BottleLedgerEvent(
        event_id="EV-1", bottle_id="BOT-1", assignment_id="",
        event_type=BottleLedgerEventType.BLOQUEO, actor_user_id="USR-1",
        previous_balance=1.0, new_balance=1.0,
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_bottle_ledger_event(event)
